Hi all —

I put together the tech checklist and initial guidance below. Happy to jump on a call to walk through.

Technical checklist / what we need from Acme to stand up POC:
1) VPC peering
   - Confirm peer VPC CIDR(s) and preferred peering model (you mentioned non-transit peering).
   - Routes: add route to Redwood peer CIDR once peering is established; we’ll provide our peer CIDR in the tech sync.
   - Security groups / firewall: please confirm any outbound port restrictions; we use TCP 443 and outbound 80/443 for telemetry.

2) IP allowlists / egress
   - If you need single static IPs, we can provide static egress IPs for the POC: 54.210.123.45 and 52.11.98.200 (or use a small CIDR range).
   - If your infra requires source NATs / private peering only, let us know and we’ll adjust the deployment model.

3) SSO / SAML
   - Provide Okta SAML metadata URL, ACS URL, and test user for IdP validation.
   - SP values for Redwood: ACS URL = https://login.redwood.ai/saml/acs, Entity ID = https://redwood.ai/saml/sp
   - If you prefer, we can do a short Okta admin-to-admin session to exchange metadata and test sign-on.

4) Secrets / KMS
   - For POC we recommend using an AWS-managed CMK to avoid onboarding friction. If your security policy requires a customer-managed CMK, please provide key ARN and confirm whether HSM-backed (AWS CloudHSM) is required.
   - We support integrating with customer KMS via IAM roles and key aliases; we’ll need an IAM role ARN that can decrypt for the POC service.

Potential blockers / notes:
 - If Acme mandates HSM-backed CMKs for POC, there may be a 1–2 week delay while keys are provisioned and access is validated.
 - If you need non-public egress (no public IPs), we’ll need a secure peering + NAT setup; that increases setup time by ~3 business days.

Next steps:
 - Sam / Michael: confirm whether the POC can use our static egress IPs above or if you need customer-managed NAT.
 - Provide Okta metadata and test account details.
 - I’ll publish a 1–2 page runbook (network diagram + checklist) by EOD today and share in the MAP doc.

Thanks —
